description: Create a sender for quotes and invoices. This data is printed on legal documents such as quotes and invoices, so use only what the user gives you and never invent or guess a value. An invoice cannot be finalized without the company name, full address, and a tax number or VAT ID; bank details belong on it if the customer pays by transfer. The result names what is still missing.

city.description: Required before an invoice can be finalized

postalCode.description: Required before an invoice can be finalized

street.description: Street and number. Required before an invoice can be finalized

companyName.description: Real legal company name, as on the commercial register or tax registration

isDefault.description: Marks the preselected sender in the app. A tool call still has to pass billingEntityId

isSmallBusiness.description: Kleinunternehmer under section 19 UStG: no VAT is charged. Only if the user says so

taxNumber.description: Steuernummer. A German invoice needs this or vatId

vatId.description: USt-IdNr. A German invoice needs this or taxNumber

name: create_billing_entity
title: Create billing entity
